title: A deactivated term shows as inactive on the customer, plain on invoices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure customer A holds Net 60, which is deactivated, and has an invoice A created after Net 60 was deactivated.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's customer page.
  2. Open Edit Customer.
  3. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
  4. Press Escape.
  5. Click Save without changing anything.
  6. Open invoice A's printed invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card's "Credit term" reads "Net 60 (Inactive)".

Step 2:

  • Credit Terms shows "Net 60 (Inactive)" selected.

Step 3:

  • "Net 60 (Inactive)" is listed after all the active terms (after Credit Hold).

Step 4:

  • The dropdown closes, still on Net 60 (Inactive).

Step 5:

  • The customer saves and stays on Net 60 (Inactive).

Step 6:

  • The terms read "Net 60", without "(Inactive)".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer), story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S5-R7: “On Edit Customer, a customer whose term was deactivated shows it as "{name} (Inactive)" in the dropdown, selected, listed after the active terms.”
  • S5-R8: “The customer card's "Credit term" shows "{name} (Inactive)" for a deactivated term. Invoices and printed documents show the plain name.”
  • S5-R12: “The inactive term stays selected until the user picks another term.”
  • Terminology: “Inactive → A deactivated term: absent from the customer and vendor pickers, still held by whoever had it, and shown as "{name} (Inactive)" on their card and in Edit.”
  • Key Decisions: “Deactivating a term hides it from the customer and vendor pickers only. Everyone on it keeps it, shown as "{name} (Inactive)" on their card and in Edit, until someone picks another term; invoices print the plain name; it can be reactivated at any time.”
  • S7-E1: “A deactivated term still dates invoices and vendor invoices for the customers and vendors that keep it.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
